content_text:
Hello Team Deakins,
I hope you all are having a wonderful start to your year! For a while now i’ve been listening to the podcast and think that Nicholas Britell would be a really interesting and fun guest. He is a film composer most known for his work on ‘Moonlight’, ‘If Beale Street Could Talk’, and ‘Succession’. I have found his music to be some of the most unique, moving, and emotionally stimulating tunes out there (I am a big fan of his). He seems like a lovely guy who would have a lot of meaningful things to say. I hope you have a great week!
Best,
Shea
